scene: The caught crab clicks cheerfully, pointing towards departures awaiting along the boardwalk.
picture: Flat side view along a wooden boardwalk over rocky surf. Far left, a striped hot-air balloon basket rests tethered. Centre left, a metal chairlift hangs from cables overhead. In the centre, the boy in orange vest holds the ticking crab. Far right, a frost-covered sleigh tram waits open on frosty rails.
shown: a striped hot-air balloon tethered to a post on the far left
a dangling chairlift seat swinging empty from a high cable centre left
a brass sleigh tram resting on frozen rails on the far right
